description:
FILED s513i (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-10) while building the Encode shim (#2946).

SILENT WRONG, pre-existing (main e0b61a99): a scalar passed to a sub defined in ANOTHER FILE (a module) that writes through $_[N] keeps its old value when the caller's variable got a RAW slot -- the #189 writes_args fact is computed per FILE (Parser2 sub_info from the callee's body), and a module's subs never contribute it to the caller's compile, so `arg-to-writer` never fires and raw-slot passes a VALUE.

    # scratch/s513i/m/WA.pm:  package WA; sub app { $_[0] .= "x"; 1 } 1;
    use lib "scratch/s513i/m"; use WA;
    my $s = "a"; WA::app($s); print "$s\n";               # perl ax   PCL a
    my %h = (k => "a"); WA::app($h{k}); print "$h{k}\n";  # perl ax   PCL ax (an element is a box)
    PCL_OPT=none: ax ax (= perl) -- the raw-slot verdict is the half that loses it.

VICTIMS: every module API that writes its argument in place -- Encode's CHECK remainder (`decode($e, $src, FB_QUIET)` leaves the unprocessed bytes in $src; `from_to($s, ...)` converts in place; `Encode::_utf8_on($s)`), Text::Balanced (#2860's shape, cross-file), Tie::File (#2636's family).  The Encode guard Pl/t/encode-shim-01.t asserts the in-place rows through HASH ELEMENTS (boxes) for this reason; the plain-variable spelling is this task.

FIX SHAPE (a compiler change, emission-changing -- out of s513i's scope): carry `writes_args` per sub in the ProtoCache module record (beside prototypes / import_effects), merge it into known_subs at `use`, and let VarAnnotator's `arg-to-writer` arm read it for imported AND package-qualified callees (the qualified spelling `WA::app` must resolve to the record too -- #2636 notes a qualified call to a same-file sub copies as well).  Bar: the repro above == perl with optimisations on; Encode rows with a plain `my` source; the cache key carries it (a parse fact of the callee, #1704's rule).
Related: #2636 (method/qualified/coderef copies), #2860 (the prototype half, same-file), #189.
subject: A scalar passed to a sub defined in ANOTHER FILE that writes through $_[N] keeps its old value when the caller gave it a raw slot (writes_args is per-file) -- Encode FB_QUIET remainder, from_to, _utf8_on
